title: Takeaways from Investor Day 2026: Brookfield Asset Management
description:
From the rapid expansion of AI and energy infrastructure to growing opportunities in credit, powerful global trends are reshaping the investment landscape. On this episode of Brookfield Perspectives, we share highlights from Brookfield Asset Management’s 2026 Investor Day, exploring how the firm is capitalizing on these trends and leveraging its global scale, operating expertise and disciplined investment approach to drive its next phase of growth.


Please read this disclaimer (https://www.brookfield.com/podcast-disclaimer)  (https://www.brookfield.com/podcast-disclaimer) before listening.
